image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a green common iguana (Iguana iguana) perched on a textured branch or rock. The image focuses on the head, neck, and front torso. Key features visible include the large subtympanic shield, the serrated dorsal crest, the dewlap with intricate scale patterns, and the muscular forelimb with clawed digits. The background is softly blurred (bokeh), emphasizing the subject.
